title: Read arguments for a command from a file using xargs
summary: Use xargs to read arguments from a file instead of standard input. This is useful when you have a list of items in a text file that you want to pass to a command.

steps.explain: Use the --arg-file flag to specify a file containing the arguments. xargs will read the file and pass its contents as arguments to the command.

placeholders.name: FILE
placeholders.description: Path to the file containing arguments
